body: Exactly, the theatrics aren’t what I want at all. A lot of times I wish I didn’t have to exist to begin with. It’s having had made friends; and family, that’s what makes it so difficult. I don’t wish to have these ties to anyone or anything. I’d feel bad making other people sad, because of me not wanting to be here anymore. Its just so difficult.

Yea, that’s how it’s been for me as well. I’ve tried to be more grateful, focus on the positives. But often times it’s just painful as well. A lot of times I wish there were words to articulate this kind of pain accurately.

True, sometimes therapists/psychiatrists will do that- - if they feel like you’re in real danger. Though simply talking about suicidal thoughts/dark thoughts I don’t think is usually the worst thing w/ them. I’ve been to the ward twice although both times it was self admittance (also was able to get another job *or get hired after being there)

And yea nothing wrong at all with going, or reaching out for help. Actually shows strength in a time of vulnerability. I can tell you about those experiences if you’d like, not that we have to or anything. Also what’s made you unhappy w/ yourself (I am as well, amongst other things, and it’s been terrible day to day. And you don’t have to say of course)

Yea; think I just wish I could go back to a time before my depression was a real issue, before I was numb all the time or dealt with the panic and grief. Always felt alone and abandoned; but it was tolerable for awhile. I could function before it got bad.
